x: In this race Tommy Payne set out as though he was determined to shift the record for good and all to somewhere about 7hrs. 30mins. Certainly, his times stand as a warning; but, in spite of this, they also compel admiration and may well be recorded here —

A close calculation reveals that Tommy Payne passed the 50 Kilometres mark in about 4 hrs. 34 min. 40 sec. in his abortive attempt on the Brighton record in April, 1920, when he walked so brilliantly for about 37 miles but failed to finish the journey.
